HIGH COMMAND
These commands are most useful to members of the High Commands, and some commands are further restricted to higher levels of command. Many of the brigade commands take the brigade "shortname" when used.
/ALLIED (TEXT): Broadcasts text to all Allied players (restricted to Div CO and above) /AXIS (TEXT): Broadcasts text to all Axis players (restricted to Div CO and above) /HOLD: Removes the infantry spawn limits on friendly depots. Also known as "Hold At All Costs" or "HAAC". /HOLD (CODE): Votes for a HOLD on the given overrun code. /FALLBACK: Proposes a "Fallback" response to the overrun at your current town. If approved, this will sacrifice the Armybases in the town in order to open up incoming Firebases. Intended to allow you to break a camp situation. (Divisions cannot fallback. All brigades present must have valid fallback destinations). /FALLBACK (CODE): Votes for a FALL on the given overrun code. /HCCP: Brings up the High Command Control Panel. /LASTMOVES: Lists the last movements of brigades. /OICVOLUNTEER (BRIGADE): Informs your High Command that you volunteer to take charge of your current (or the specified) brigade. (Note: this is restricted to HC players) /OICNOMINATE (BRIGADE) (PLAYER): Notifies your High Command that you nominate the named player to be in charge of the named brigade.(Note: this is restricted to HC players) /OICVETO (BRIGADE) (PLAYER): Vetoes the nomination of the named player to become OIC of the named brigade. /OICRESIGN (BRIGADE): The OIC resigns leadership of the named brigade. /OICREPLACE (BRIGADE): You replace the current OIC of the named brigade. /OICREMOVE (BRIGADE) (PLAYER): Remove the named player from the OIC position in the named brigade. /HC: Displays online HC members and OICS, as well as their brigade assignments. /HCLIST: Displays the names of all HC members online, including OIC's. /HOME: Reports the prestige "home" of your brigade - not its actual location. /HOME (with town selected on map): (Brigade Owners only) Allows the official Officer in Charge of a brigade to update its prestige "home" location. /LISTOICS: Displays a list of current OIC assignments.
